ACTUAL FINITE-POLYHEDRON EHRHARD CONCAVITY

Classical theorem; this is formal infrastructure, not a new priority claim.

The starting dependency is the OpenAI smooth Ehrhard proof, pinned to
openai/math@1581d4cbdd69a0faf34b2089614fe2a814316a6a and copied verbatim from the
vendor snapshot in pmaronow/slowequilibration-palomar@a28aaa336343c4caf43791ababd8ed0ee5c7b58e.
All 12 dependency files compile unchanged. OPENAI-EHRHARD-PROVENANCE.json records
the exact hashes and OPENAI-MATH-LICENSE preserves Apache-2.0 licensing.

NEW PROVED EXTENSION
Namespace NegativeVotingEhrhard.
closedPolyhedron w b = {x : EuclideanSpace R i | forall j, <w_j,x> <= b_j}.
translatedPolyhedronMass w b x is the actual standard-Gaussian integral of
1_C(x+z), and is proved equal to gamma(C-x).

gaussian_polyhedron_ehrhard_concave proves:
  0 < gamma(C) < 1 implies x |-> Phi^{-1}(gamma(C-x)) is concave on the full space.
The normals and offsets are arbitrary. Redundant, coincident, and zero normals
are allowed. There is no positivity assumption on each individual inequality,
no boundary-nullness assumption, and no smoothness premise on the polyhedron.

The proof constructs f_n(x) = n - sum_j log(1+exp(n^2*(<w_j,x>-b_j))).
GaussianSoftPolyhedron.lean proves the actual gradient and Hessian, continuity,
global bounds, concavity, and applicability of the checked smooth Ehrhard theorem.
GaussianPolyhedronEhrhard.lean proves Phi(f_n(x)) -> 1_C(x) at every point, including
the boundary. A bound of one supplies dominated convergence for the actual heat
integrals. Inverse-CDF continuity transfers their limits. Pointwise limits preserve
the concavity inequality. Finally, the positive Gaussian translation density
proves all translated masses are in (0,1) from the original mass assumption alone.

VERIFICATION
GaussianSoftPolyhedron.lean and GaussianPolyhedronEhrhard.lean build successfully.
All 43 public declarations in these two modules pass transitive #print axioms
checks with only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. Exact source hashes
and the full declaration audit are in EHRHARD_POLYHEDRON_VERIFICATION.json.
The imported 12-file closure and its principal semantic endpoints have a separate
EHRHARD_UPSTREAM_VERIFICATION.json receipt.

CALCULUS BRIDGE
GaussianEhrhardCurvature.lean derives the scalar consequence
  phi(q(p(0))) * p''(0) + q(p(0)) * p'(0)^2 <= 0
from actual concavity of q composed with p and ordinary first/second derivative
hypotheses. It is kept separate from the concrete Gaussian-moment conversion,
so derivative hypotheses are never presented as a proved covariance theorem.

REPRODUCTION
Install the version in lean-toolchain, then from this directory run:
  lake exe cache get
  lake build GaussianPolyhedronEhrhard GaussianEhrhardCurvature
  lake env lean EhrhardUpstreamAudit.lean
  lake env lean EhrhardPolyhedronAudit.lean
  lake env lean EhrhardCurvatureAudit.lean
The local development checkout reuses an existing cache via .lake/packages;
that cache is not source material and is not part of the proof archive.
